name: stack-viewer
description: A side pane that maps every component your session runs and where it is installed from: skills, subagents, commands, hooks, MCP servers, plugins and mods, settings, memory and output styles. Pick a type in the sidebar to see its scopes as a tree in precedence order (Enterprise, CLI flag, Local, Project, User, Plugin, Built-in) with what each one holds, and which components are active, shadowed by a higher scope, or off.

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane in the fullscreen layout (40-140); a width you drag it to wins
